title: 第五章 直播间里的狂少第六章 直播间里的土豪
content_zh:
“是你！”
秦九儿见到陆原的一刹那，都愣了。
“是你？”
陆原有点无语，怎么那个德克士里的女生，竟然是何敏的室友啊。
“怎么，你们俩认识吗，那太好了啊！”
何敏也愣了，是啊，看这个样子，这两人好像还认识啊，她没想到竟然会这样。
“是的哦，我们当然认识。”
秦九儿嘴角露出讥讽的微笑，“你知道他是谁吗，他就是那个在德克士里偷吃我东西的男生！”
啊！
众人顿时都被震住了。
有那么一会儿，谁都没有说话。
不知道该怎么说啊。
这种场合，感觉说什么，都不合适。
说到底，还是宿舍里的兄弟们亲。
张辉此时脸也不红了，也不局促了，恼火的冲着陆原说道：“老陆，你都没钱吃饭了，怎么也不跟兄弟们说说啊！你太不把我们当成兄弟了！”
“是啊，老陆，这你就做的不对了。”宋纯也说道。
“老陆，快坐下来吧，这回啊，好好给你补一补，那个，九儿啊，你们这也算是缘分啊，是不是。”陈锋打着圆场说道。
陆原没说啥，也就坐下了。
秦九儿却站了起来。
“算了，我不吃了，我还有事，先走了。”

说着，秦九儿抓起包包就走。
秦九儿自己也有自己的想法，本来嘛，她其实真的是抱着认识一个男生的想法来的，而且，来之前，她也想象着陈锋宿舍里的男生都是高富帅，自己能交到一个男朋友那是最好不过了。
以后陈锋何敏，自己和那个男生，四个人一起出去玩，多开心。
然而，没想到，陈锋宿舍里的都是张辉和宋纯那样的。
而自己一直在期盼最后这个陆原，期盼了半天，竟然……
落差太大了，真是不想多说了。
秦九儿别提多郁闷了。
她抓起包包，刚站起来走两步。
一个男生却突然挡住了她。
这男生，个子不高，但是穿的很洋气，手腕上有一块劳力士。
手里还端着两杯红酒。
“美女，我和朋友们玩真心话大冒险，我输了，要求请一位美丽的女生和我喝一杯红酒，可以赏个脸吗？”
男生说话的语气有点吊儿郎当，看来平时肯定也是一个很嚣张的人。
看男生的样子，也应该有点钱。
不过秦九儿虽然喜欢富二代，但是也绝不是来者不拒。
content_en:
"It's you!"
The moment Qin Jiuer saw Lu Yuan, he was stunned.
"Is it you?"
Lu Yuan was a little speechless. How come that girl from Dix was actually He Min's roommate.
"Why, do you two know each other? That would be great!"
He Min was also stunned. Yes, it looked like the two of them knew each other. She didn't expect this to happen.
"Yes, of course we know each other."
Qin Jiuer's mouth showed a sarcastic smile, "Do you know who he is? He is the boy who stole my food in Dicos!"
Ah!
Everyone was immediately shocked.
For a moment, no one spoke.
I don’t know what to say.
In this situation, it feels like nothing is appropriate.
After all, we are still brothers in the dormitory.
Zhang Hui was no longer blushing or embarrassed at this time, and said angrily to Lu Yuan: "Old Lu, you don't have money to eat, why don't you talk to your brothers! You don't regard us as brothers!"
"Yes, Lao Lu, you are doing something wrong." Song Chunye said.
"Lao Lu, sit down quickly. This time, I'll give you a good patch. Well, Jiu'er, you guys are kind of destined, right?" Chen Feng said to smooth things over.
Lu Yuan didn't say anything and sat down.
Qin Jiuer stood up.
"Forget it, I won't eat. I have other things to do, so I'll leave first."
With that said, Qin Jiuer grabbed the bag and left.
Qin Jiu'er also had her own thoughts. Originally, she really came with the idea of ​​meeting a boy. Moreover, before coming, she also imagined that the boys in Chen Feng's dormitory were all rich and handsome. It would be the best if she could get a boyfriend.
From now on, Chen Feng, He Min, and that boy will go out and play together, how happy they will be.
However, he didn't expect that everyone in Chen Feng's dormitory was like Zhang Hui and Song Chun.
And I have been looking forward to the last Lu Yuan. I have been looking forward to it for a long time, and unexpectedly...
The gap is so big that I really don’t want to say more.
Qin Jiuer was extremely depressed.
She grabbed her bag and just stood up and took two steps.
A boy suddenly blocked her.
This boy is not tall, but he is dressed very stylishly and has a Rolex on his wrist.
There were two glasses of red wine in his hand.
"Beauty, I played truth or dare with my friends. I lost. I asked a beautiful girl to have a glass of red wine with me. Can I give you a face?"
The boy's tone of voice was a bit carefree, and it seemed that he must be a very arrogant person at ordinary times.
Judging from the boy's appearance, he should have some money.
However, although Qin Jiuer likes the second generation of rich people, he does not reject anyone who comes.
